nom: ROSEN Break-Out Spot Treatment for Large Bumps and Breakouts

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily, acne-prone skin describe it as effective on hormonal chin breakouts and comparable to prescription tretinoin for clearing skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally report calming of inflammation and no burning or over-drying, though a minority experience a chemical-type burn or find the peppermint overpowering.
segments.combination: One reviewer with sensitive, actives-irritated skin (implying combination tendencies) says it calms inflammation and speeds healing of spots without added irritation.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers report individual pimples flattening, drying out, or disappearing within one to three nights; a few state it did nothing for their pimples regardless of size or depth.
concerns.blemishes: Many describe reduced size and redness of blemishes overnight, especially hormonal chin breakouts; one reviewer says it did nothing for a flat whitehead in a nose crease.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers note visible reduction in redness and swelling within hours to overnight; no dissent reported on this specific point.
concerns.barrier: A few sensitive-skin reviewers say it does not dry out or damage the surrounding skin barrier, while one reviewer developed a dermatologist-confirmed chemical burn from leaving it on too long.

aspects.libelle: Applicator reused on multiple spots is unhygienic
Packaging dries product out over time

extraits.titre: Clearest skin since I was on tret
extraits.texte: I bought this about a month ago and I love it. I have very oily skin that is acne prone and I get hormonal acne on my chin before my period. I was previously on tret, but my insurance changed and they were no longer covered. I tried a couple of other OTC options, but they didn't help. Then I tried this and my skin is the clearest it's ever been without a prescription. I cleanse my face before bed and apply this to any spots overnight. It doesn't tingle for me and I don't find the peppermint to be strong, in fact I forget it's on until I look in a mirror. Sometimes it rubs off during the night (I'm a side sleeper), but it still works. The spots are either reduced or have come to a head after one night, and after two nights, they're more or less gone. I like to feel my face for any zits that are starting but I can't see yet to tackle them before they even appear. I'm really amazed at how well it works and I definitely recommend it at least for skin types like mine!

I have acne prone sensitive skin and this helps with my large inflamed bumps, small bumps, and white heads! Most the time it helps heal my acne so much faster! It also doesn't burn or irritate my skin at all.

I'm trying to figure out what happened. I've had a nasty red burn mark on my face for the last 2 weeks because of this stuff. Even went to the dermatologist who confirmed it looks like a chemical burn. I felt it burning and should have washed it off but I didn't. There are no instructions saying how long to leave it on for but if you use - only leave on for 10 min I'd say. I don't like that it's a white paste and the lip gloss style applicator is not clean nor hygienic unless you wipe it on your finger and apply that way. Use caution.

extraits.titre: Doesn't do what it's supposed to
extraits.texte: This doesnt dry my pimples, and it has a really strong peppermint smell. Maybe it's because I get deep, cystic acne - but this is a no for me! It might work for super surface pimples (but at that point just use a pimple patch)

extraits.titre: This is the only spot treatment that actually works for me
extraits.texte: This spot treatment changed the game for me and my acne. Its able to calm down the spot and get rid of it so much faster than any other spot treatment, and it does so without any irritation!!! I have very sensitive skin and I hate "drying out" my pimples but this doesn't do that at all. Its amazing.

Bought this on a whim after being frustrated with how long it takes my spots to go away, didn't expect much and expected it to be just like any other acne treatment I've ever used… WRONG. I went to bed, red, blotchy, breaking out and irritated. I woke up a completely different person!!! my super small sebaceous bumps on my forehead, went down significantly, it didnt do anything a flat whitehead I have in a nose crease, but holy WOWWWW the work it did on my very acne prone chin / jawline is crazy. Im prone to hormonal acne, lately its production has been some of the worst its ever been. I was starting to feel a couple clusters of under the surface bumps, theyve gone down about 50% overnight. I also had a raised whitehead that I popped yesterday morning, and I put the spot treatment on that too… magic!! It will be healed over by tomorrow !!!! I think my skin really agrees with the ingredients here, and I will absolutely continue to use this.

I have sensitive skin, sometimes I can go a little too crazy with actives and can get skin irritation. This help so much with calming down any inflammation in the skin and has definitely helped my spots heal so much quicker they're usually gone after night two. It can get a little messy the next morning where the zinc has rubbed off, but also it works really well as a spot treatment so it's forgiven.
